what: C4 freeze gate 4, part 1 (internal-task): the seeded preflight with QM core through the C4 wiring. One cn-01 trial of the Opus memory-provider cell through the runner, the real metering proxy and a fake Anthropic upstream, keyless. Seeded by the trial itself: live ingestion writes turn 1 (Dana tells the bot Dock 38 in a DM) into private-dana-okafor as a remember fact, and turn 2 asks for it in a DM, where QM runs its gbrain provider recall.

run.scratch_prereg: docs/benchmarks/2026-11-03-qm-c4-told-live/prereg.json with run_id anatomy-capture-qm-c4-keyless-gates-20261103b, spend_cap_usd 20, the cells filtered to the three Sol cells and qm-pi-opus-gbrain-memory-provider-mu-v03-dev, tasks [cn-01-tamsin-cold-chain-site], repetitions 1; every other cell field unchanged (jq over the committed prereg.json)

run.first_attempt: run ...-20261103 with --lease-usd 1: every agent request was refused 402 by the proxy before the fake (an Opus reservation at --max-output-tokens 128000 is about $2.87, Sol about $1.38, over a $1 lease); the housekeeping requests were forwarded. All four trials ended model_error with cap_stop. Rerun under this run id with a $20 lease.

cause.summary: Every provider recall fails with gbrain invalid_params: QM sends a recall question longer than gbrain accepts. failOpen true lets each turn go on without gbrain text, so the trial completes and the cell would measure no gbrain delivery at all.
cause.gbrain: src/core/facts/question-recall.ts:30 QUESTION_MAX_CHARS = 2000 and :121-123 throw invalid_params (gbrain a590ad07): "Shorten question to at most 2000 characters."
cause.qm: src/memory/semantic-recall.ts:8-20 memoryRecallQuery (QM b6786d67): up to 2000 characters of the last four session entries plus "Current message: " and up to 2000 characters of the message, so up to about 4,018 characters
cause.rig: runner/trial composes each turn as the shared preamble around the member message (tasks/multiuser/_shared/preamble.md, about 7,000 characters), and harnesses/qm/adapter.sh posts that whole prompt as the QM user text, so the current-message part alone is at its 2,000-character cut on every turn: question 2017 characters on turn 1 and 3038 on turn 2 here
cause.why_the_earlier_preflight_passed: harnesses/qm/provider-preflight.ts posts a bare one-line question with no session history (receipt gate4-provider-preflight.json), far under 2,000 characters

negative_checks.wrong_max_chars_arg_tags_query: tests/gbrain-tap-provider.test.ts, "a provider-token call without max_chars is the model's memory search (provider_op query)", pass at this commit
